text: {"frames":["The mill on the Tower's lowest canal began to turn on a still morning, though no wind stirred the reeds. Pim climbed the ladder and found the sails creaking with nothing to push them. Below, the flour sacks stood in two rows, and a note lay under the millstone. The left row held {a} sacks and the right row held {b}. Which sign goes between {a} and {b}, with the left row first?","An empty boat bumped against the lock gate before the sun was up, and Lot pulled it in. Nobody sat in it, but a small casket with a rusty lock lay on the bench. Inside the lid someone had scratched two counts, one for the cheese stall and one for the bakery. The cheese stall had {a} clogs and the bakery had {b}. Which sign goes between {a} and {b}, with the cheese stall's count first?","All the windows of the crooked house with the hoist beam glowed blue, though the door was bolted and nobody lived there. Joop found a cheese missing from the cellar shelf, and the rope above the attic was still swinging. Someone had chalked tallies on the beam. {a} cheeses had gone up the rope, and {b} had come down. Which sign goes between {a} and {b}, with the cheeses that went up counted first?","A smell of warm waffles and wet wool drifted down into the cellar every night. Femke followed it and found a new shadow on the wall, the shape of someone with a yoke and buckets. Beside the shadow, somebody had chalked two rows of buckets. The left row had {a} buckets and the right row had {b}. Which sign goes between {a} and {b}, with the left row first?","A man in a wet cap held out an old map and asked Thijs for help before he gave his name. On the map a canal ran through the third floor of the Tower, and nobody in Misty Ford remembered digging it. Along its banks someone had written how many herring barrels stood on each side. The west bank had {a} barrels and the east bank had {b}. Which sign goes between {a} and {b}, with the west bank first, so the canal can be found?"]}
